author: Dthufyufyugyygy
title: Great game 🔥🔥🔥 just needs some nirvana 🔥🔥🙏🙏
content:
Magic Tiles 3 is one of the most addictive rhythm games I’ve played.The gameplay is simple — tap the tiles in time with the music — but it gets fast, intense, and surprisingly challenging. The song library is huge, covering pop, EDM, classical, and even some rock tracks. The difficulty ramps up smoothly, so beginners can enjoy it while more experienced players can chase perfect scores.

The visuals are clean, the controls respond well, and the game rarely feels unfair. It’s the kind of game you open for “just one round” and suddenly an hour disappears. The only downside is that some songs require ads or purchases to unlock, but that’s pretty normal for mobile rhythm games.

My biggest wish? More rock and grunge.Magic Tiles 3 has a few heavier songs, but I’d love to see some Nirvana tracks added — especially classics like Heart‑Shaped Box, In Bloom,or Serve the Servants.Their riffs and melodies would fit perfectly into the fast‑paced tapping style and give fans of alternative rock something to look forward to.

Overall:Magic Tiles 3 is a great rhythm game with tons of replay value — and it would be even better with some iconic Nirvana songs in the mix.
